connector.name: Grandline MCP by luzomi
connector.registryDescription: Empirical maritime distances from real AIS tracks: 4 route variants, port lookup, bulk matrix
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package grandline-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the luzomi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GRANDLINE_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer token from grandline.luzomi.com/register. Omit to use the anonymous tier (5 calls total per IP).

env.name: GRANDLINE_API_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (default https://grandline.luzomi.com/api/v1).
